skill.name: calil-books
skill.description: Search Japanese library holdings and loan availability through the Calil API. Requires a free API key and excludes book purchases, ebooks, and National Diet Library searches.
skill.summary: Find Japanese libraries, check books by ISBN, and interpret borrowing availability with bounded API polling.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: All 42 static findings are benign Markdown formatting, expected Calil URLs, readable Japanese prose, library identifiers, or a fixed documentation link. No evidence found of prompt injection, malicious execution, or unauthorized data transmission in SKILL.md. One low-severity semantic finding concerns API keys exposed through expanded curl command arguments.

remediation.issue: API keys expand into curl URL arguments and may become visible through process inspection or captured command logs.
remediation.suggestion: Use an HTTP client that reads CALIL_APPKEY inside its process, rather than passing the key as a command argument. Redact appkey from logs.

content.user_title: Find Books Available at Japanese Libraries
content.value_statement: Finding a book nearby requires checking library holdings and current loan status. This skill guides Calil API searches and turns availability responses into clear borrowing options.
actual_capabilities: Guide library searches by prefecture, municipality, or geographic coordinates using the Calil API.
Check holdings and loan status for 10-digit or 13-digit ISBNs across multiple library systems.
Use documented Tokyo library identifiers when the user lives in Tokyo and does not specify libraries.
Poll asynchronous sessions at intervals of at least two seconds, capped at ten attempts or approximately two minutes.
Interpret branch-level borrowing statuses and surface reservation links when the API provides them.
Distinguish absent holdings from API failures and guide bounded retries for server errors.
limitations: Live searches require a Calil account, a valid API key, network access, and an environment capable of making HTTP requests.
Book purchases, ebooks, and National Diet Library searches are outside scope.
Holdings queries require ISBNs; title-to-ISBN discovery and completed reservations are not provided.
Availability and caching depend on Calil coverage and terms; the referenced shared response checklist is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Find a Borrowable Book Nearby
use_cases.description: A local reader supplies an ISBN and municipality to identify libraries reporting available copies.

use_cases.title: Compare Course Reading Availability
use_cases.description: A student checks several ISBNs across selected library systems and separates available copies from checked-out or absent holdings.

use_cases.title: Support Regional Reading Research
use_cases.description: A researcher compares holdings across municipalities while recording uncertain statuses and respecting caching limits.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Local Libraries
prompt_templates.prompt: Find libraries in [prefecture] and [municipality] using Calil. Show their formal names and library system identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: identify libraries before checking a book.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Book
prompt_templates.prompt: Check ISBN [ISBN] in [library system]. Report branch-level loan status and any reservation link returned by Calil.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: inspect one book at a chosen library system.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Books
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ISBNs [ISBN list] across [library systems]. Group results into available, unavailable, absent, and uncertain holdings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare several books and library systems.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Asynchronous Regional Searches
prompt_templates.prompt: Find library systems in [region] and check [ISBN list]. Poll at least two seconds apart, stopping after ten attempts or two minutes. Distinguish API failures from absent holdings. Never display the API key.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate regional discovery, batch checks, and bounded polling.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: summarize a completed lookup with available, checked-out, and absent branch results.
output: Illustrative output, not a live lookup.
Branch B: checked out; a reservation link was provided.
Branch C: no holdings. This is a normal result, not an API failure.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: the API continues processing after the polling limit.
output_examples.output: Illustrative output: The library lookup did not finish within the polling limit. No final availability result is available. Please try again later.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: a branch reports holdings without a clear loan status.
output_examples.output: Illustrative output: The branch holds the book, but borrowing availability is unknown. Contact the library before visiting.

best_practices: Keep CALIL_APPKEY private and avoid exposing expanded credential URLs in process arguments or logs.
Confirm the ISBN and region before searching; discover regional library identifiers instead of assuming Tokyo defaults.
Request plain JSON, enforce timeouts and polling limits, and follow Calil usage and caching terms.
anti_patterns: Pasting API keys into chats, source files, commits, or visible command logs.
Polling indefinitely, ignoring request limits, or permanently storing API results without checking the terms.
Treating absent holdings as an API error or uncertain holdings as guaranteed borrowing availability.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a Calil account and obtain a free API key from its dashboard. Keep the key private.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live lookups also require network access and an HTTP-capable execution environment.

faq.question: Can I search by book title?
faq.answer: The documented holdings workflow requires a 10-digit or 13-digit ISBN. The skill does not provide title-to-ISBN discovery.

faq.question: Is the skill limited to Tokyo?
faq.answer: No. It can discover library systems in other Japanese regions. Tokyo defaults apply only when the user lives there and specifies no libraries.

faq.question: Can it reserve or purchase a book?
faq.answer: It can show reservation links returned by Calil, but it does not complete reservations. Purchases and ebooks are outside scope.

faq.question: Why can an availability lookup take time?
faq.answer: Calil checks holdings asynchronously. The skill polls with the returned session and stops after ten attempts or approximately two minutes.
